notes.title: Second big patch this game should be fairer now
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing the game! I've decided to make it easier and also to fix some of the "bugs" (i thin kthey made the game funny but also some of them were unintentional). Here's a list of the changes:

[list]
[*] Added a guy that gives instructions for the fishing rod and hints about the zombie leg
[*] Fixed the fire hydrant coin showing up too early
[*] Added Saiphe 
[*] Fixed sandbox buildings spawning in all worlds. Whoops! (This means your buildings will be deleted in this update. Sorry. If you want me to transfer them for you, I can in the discord.
[*] Fixed the Ant telling you how many coins are in the level
[*]  Fat bunny doesnt get so close to you (and doesnt push you off stage anymore)
[*] Changed position of second shoe in ghoul world so you can find it easier
[*] Changed spawning position for burger, it should be obvious where it is now. 
[*] Reduced size of textures, it was really funny having 4k textures but 10gb is a lot for this game
[/list]

Thank you to Saiphe, GamerGhoulFriend, and KiraKira on twitch for pointing out these bugs to me over twitch. And FeLucaBird too!

Known bugs:
[list]
[*] Negative Coin Count
[*] EFT achievement happening too early
[*] Slider sensitivity too low for mouse 
[*] Herobrine
[*] Can't back on menus with controller B button (but you can press escape)
[/list]
These changes are for WINDOWS ONLY. Mac update coming soon.

notes.title: Patches for Windows
notes.content:
These are build fixes for WINDOWS. Mac tomorrow after the compilation completes.

[list]
[*] Fixed the placement of the quest waypoint in Mansion World.
[*] Added Tutorial For Staff Lock On in Mansion world.
[*] Jungle hydrant quest now gets completed, now gives a coin. Total coin amt increased to 46.
[*] Fixed coffee maker quest location.
[*] increase fishing chances so fishing should be faster.
[*] Springs in Kaiju world are red now instead of b+w.
[*] Talk to woman farmer placement fixed for final waypoint.
[*] Momma Mushroom quest now completable.
[*] Added cauldron to otuside castle / coloseum so no more soft lock.
[*] Zombies truly max out at 180 now in the Farm world.
[*] You no longer hold fire while placing fire.
[*] Increased size of burger so you can't miss it when you get it from craftyworld guys.
[*] Fixed COIN and EFT count for quests.
[*] If your controller is plugged in, you should be able to still see keyboard commands if you are using your mouse + keyboard (this should help for steamdeck users).
[/list]

Known issues:
[list]
[*] Slider sensitivity kinda low for the mouse sensitivity.
[*] Back button doesn't do anything in the UI
[*] Game too fun
[/list]

Shoutout to Finsiftycat, GamerGhoulFriend, KiraKira, Kreastricon, SunburntFrenchFry and many others for playing and reporting bugs in this latest build. Feel free to report more in the discord / discussion board!
